m10.text: Garruk Wildspeaker tells us that some creatures in the jungle simply cannot be hunted.
In the Onakke temple the veil-enhanced Liliana dispatches him, and the Veil's Curse webcomic about Garruk and Jace appears in the summer of 2009.

m11.text: Garruk Wildspeaker is a boy whose father Raklan tells him to hide in the forest when a Sheriff of Lord Faldus comes to conscript him.
Years later he calls a wurm that devours the Sheriff, and his spark ignites so that he planeswalks for the first time, to Shandalar.
There he hunts the Ursoth, but he rages at Liliana for killing one of his beasts and assaults her, and she uses the Chain Veil to overpower and curse him.
He seeks a cure on Ravnica, overpowers Jace before coming to his senses, and learns where Liliana was last seen.

m12.text: Garruk Wildspeaker is belittled by Jace Beleren, who explains a simple thing slowly because Garruk has only recently begun to walk upright.

m15.text: Garruk Wildspeaker is cursed with shadow by Liliana's veil, which pollutes his nature magic, and he hunts her to Innistrad.
Avacyn sends Vronos to find him and bring him to her cathedral, but the corrupted Garruk overwhelms Vronos with his beasts and wounds him with a thrown axe.
Garruk comes to see all planeswalkers as prey, kills Vronos and takes his mask as a trophy.
A suppression Hedron stops his transformation into the Worldslayer demon, and he later beheads the ice-wielding Icy, who had been hired by Vronos.

eld.text: Garruk Wildspeaker is trapped and mesmerized by Oko on Eldraine, who turns him into a servile bodyguard called Dog.
At Oko's behest he saves the Kenrith twins from Redcaps and kills the High King's guards before Oko kidnaps the king.

When Will removes the hedron, the curse runs wild and Garruk rampages, killing Cado's corrupted griffin, but the Cauldron of Eternity, summoned by Will's persistence, lifts the curse and gives him life.
He joins the twins in chasing the Wild Hunt, but he hesitates at Rowan's protest and Oko planeswalks away, so Garruk gives the twins' parents his word to find and watch over them.

fra.text: Garruk Wildspeaker is found in his lodge on Muraganda by Chandra and Ajani, who need his help against Jace, and he agrees in exchange for information about wards, seals and magical containment.
In Jace's tower he joins Vraska and the others, wanting revenge on Liliana because the witch cursed him, and the Theorist's power ruins his muscles until Tam heals him.
Garruk volunteers to carry part of Jace in his head, and he kneels by the young Jace and promises to protect the child.
In the final fight he knocks down the cryomancer double while Ajani rips away the Chain Veil, and afterward he asks Liliana whether she knows the twins and planeswalks away.
